summary: BIT ORIGIN Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting shareholder approval of a 5-for-1 reverse stock split of its Class A and Class B ordinary shares, effective August 21, 2026. The split reduces outstanding Class A shares from 3,999,568 to approximately 799,914 and Class B from 105,211 to about 21,043; fractional shares are rounded up. The par value increases proportionally, and the authorized share count is reduced. Outstanding convertible debentures (~$14.5 million aggregate principal) have their conversion price adjusted, potentially reduced to an Event Market Price if it falls below the effective conversion price. This is a capital-structure maintenance event, not a special situation; watch for potential conversion-price reset affecting dilution.
